| description = 

An uncommon monster that can be a hassle to fight if you don't have magic weapons. Useful for their [[Greater Lightstone|Greater Lightstones]], which can be sold for about 5pp to merchants or handed in for a [[Concordance of Research]] in North Karana, {{Loc|Northern Karana|-688, -159}} which can then be sold for about 10pp to [[Mrysila]] (or to the DE camp in SRo if evil). 

As an incorporeal enemy, a player must use magic spells or weapons with the "magic" tag to damage them. Similarly, magic boots are required to [[Kick]] them, magic shields are required to [[Bash]] them, and magic shoulders are required to [[Slam]] them. Will-o-wisps are social and will assist other nearby will-o-wisps in combat.
